text: I've been here several times, but the diagnoses are inaccurate and the nurses' care isn't very good. Please improve this; we're not getting free treatment. I explained my symptoms, but the doctor didn't seem to believe me, even though I had just gotten a wound that day and hadn't cleaned it yet, and it had become infected. The doctor said it had been there for a long time without doing any examination, just giving me ointment and oral medication. It was a terrible experience and I'm very disappointed with this place.

text: The clinic is clean, the doctors and nurses are lovely and the service is excellent. Social security insurance is accepted. The doctor examined me very thoroughly.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเวชกรรมกรุงเทพระยอง สาขาบ้านฉาง
text:
Do the nurses and doctors not even communicate? They rush through everything, and the examination documents are incomplete.
They said I needed to have my wound cleaned for 7 days, but the certificate says 3 days. This will cause a lot of damage to my reputation when I submit it to the relevant department at work. This is supposed to be an international hospital, but they act like a
government hospital. I don't mind paying a lot of money, but the management is like they don't want to work. Anyone who wants to experience this should try it. This is what I experienced; others might have a better experience. 🙁🙁

text: Expensive. I expected nice words and good service, but I didn't get it!! Out of the 10+ nurses, some spoke well, not all!! The person at the cashier needs to improve. Just because you're wearing a nurse's uniform and mask doesn't mean you're superior. Everyone is a person; show some respect. I paid full price here, I didn't use any benefits. I really regret spending the money. The service at a government hospital isn't any different. Don't tell me I was behaving badly; if you behaved badly first, I'll behave badly back. Improvement would be appreciated; I'm not asking for free medicine.
